nodes.description: IERC20 token that users stake into the contract
IERC20 token distributed as staking rewards
Constant reward period length of 120 days
_totalSupply; total amount of staked tokens tracked by the contract
Timestamp at which the current reward period ends
Rate of reward tokens distributed per second
Last timestamp at which reward accounting was updated
Stored accumulated reward per staked token
Address authorized to notify reward amounts
_balances mapping of user address to staked token balance
Mapping of user address to last paid reward per token value
Mapping of user address to accrued unclaimed reward amount
_owner address inherited from Ownable, controls privileged functions
stake(uint256) locks user tokens and updates reward accounting
unstake(uint256) withdraws staked tokens and updates reward accounting
exit() unstakes full balance and claims pending rewards
getReward() transfers accrued reward tokens to the caller
notifyRewardAmount(uint256) sets reward rate and period finish
setRewardDistribution(address) owner-only setter for rewardDistribution
recoverExcessToken(address,uint256) owner-only rescue of arbitrary tokens
rewardPerToken() view computing cumulative reward per staked token
earned(address) view computing accrued rewards for an account
lastTimeRewardApplicable() view returning min(block.timestamp, periodFinish)
updateReward(address) modifier refreshing global and per-user reward state
onlyRewardDistribution modifier restricting caller to rewardDistribution
onlyOwner modifier restricting caller to contract owner
VortexStaking constructor assigning stake and reward tokens
totalSupply() view returning _totalSupply
balanceOf(address) view returning staked balance of an account
msg.sender; externally controlled caller address used for authorization and accounting
block.timestamp; miner-influenced time used in reward math
stakeToken.safeTransferFrom external token transfer inside stake()
stakeToken.safeTransfer external token transfer inside unstake()
rewardToken.safeTransfer external token transfer inside getReward()
IERC20(token).safeTransfer arbitrary-token transfer inside recoverExcessToken()
amount parameter of stake(uint256)
amount parameter of unstake(uint256)
reward parameter of notifyRewardAmount(uint256)
_rewardDistribution parameter of setRewardDistribution(address)
token parameter of recoverExcessToken(address,uint256)
amount parameter of recoverExcessToken(address,uint256)
account parameter of earned(address)
account parameter of updateReward(address) modifier
local reward value computed in getReward()

unstake amount is a transient argument that only feeds the unstake() accounting flow
reward argument is only used to recompute rewardRate/periodFinish inside notifyRewardAmount()
the new distribution address is immediately stored into the rewardDistribution state variable
the token address is only used as the call target of the external safeTransfer in recoverExcessToken()
